personal.name: Shivam Mishra
personal.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
personal.bio:
Hey 👋
I'm Shivam, a Full Stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience engineering secure, scalable enterprise systems using .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET Web API, SQL Server and Strapi CMS. I pair frontend UI engineering with microservices and API design, scaled a live retail SaaS to 100+ active business users, and ship fast with AI-assisted development workflows using Claude CLI.

current.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
current.institution: Millennium Institute of Technology and Science, Bhopal

achievements: Scaled Dukaan-Core, a multi-tenant retail SaaS, to 100+ live stores and business users
Sustained 99.9% uptime on the Artemis Hospital Management System
Built enterprise platforms for Varun Beverages (Zambia and India)
Resolved 50+ bugs during the Techpile Technology development internship

experience.description: Engineered the Artemis Hospital Management System (99.9% uptime, sub-second response times), architected a decoupled headless CMS with Strapi that cut marketing publishing from days to minutes, improved page load speeds by 40%, and built the UniMarket Research Analytics Portal.

Built mission-critical backend endpoints and automated background tasks for Varun Beverages Zambia, real-time logistics tracking for the Freight Management platform, a role-based dealer rewards engine for Ajay Pipes, and maintained enterprise interfaces for VBL India.
Completed intensive production training on live ASP.NET MVC code, resolved 50+ bugs and delivered responsive student portal modules for the Student Management & Assessment System.
